content: Thlǝk Yeeso pathla aten ɗimiyirha tǝ chakhrǝghǝn ɗǝ
Ndangga Yeeso fatsahayighǝn, “Əngya na kyang niifa hu ɗimiyirha hai nǝn ɓarha ɓa, amma kawa a niifɗi ɓagha ɓa tǝghǝn.
A nggushi waghang nda fǝn hǝrha ura mughangganda ahu wuri aama ɗǝ, ma kyanggǝn tal ahur wangginiya hu ɗimiyirha hai.
Yoo, kwarama altennun.” “A ǝnad shadwa ɗimiyirha, yanang, a nda ɗǝ cheeɗa hai, chahanggǝn ɗǝ.
A ǝnoɗǝ ɗimiyirha fa sara mǝd hu parra fara, sara mǝd a wutta thlǝmad wa ɓa, ndǝghǝn, ‘Cheeɗa hai,’ chahanggǝn ɗǝ.”
Chighang fǝrƙǝkafek kan
Fathlǝngya Yeeso ndang ngganda, “Chighang fǝrƙǝkafek kan.”
Ndanggǝn kanda, “Ana fǝrƙǝkafek sǝ a fannun ƙǝla wan parsǝna, nun ndangnda ɗǝfǝdɗi na manggǝn ya, ‘Kǝɗusǝ ɗa rarha hai hu wuri aama ɗǝ,’ nǝn takkwa miwa.
Tsawud nggayid mafarha
“A ndam tal ahur nun na mafadghǝn sǝ na a huɗang sǝ nduwa na a lafang chaukhrayighǝn. Nǝn ndangnda mafadɗi a wudɗaɓa a hee, ‘Ɓoɓa nanǝn ya ɓa tsau hai hǝɓaana’?
A meghedghǝn kamngwa a ndagha, ‘Fuweesǝ ˈwan ngwana fa ƙǝla nggina ngwala hǝbrha ni tǝ sarha aɗa hǝb yiwa tǝ sarha wa’?
Nǝn usa mafadɗi, ƙǝsǝr ka ǝnanǝn taara ndangnanda ǝnagha wa?
Nuwun kee ƙǝm, a ngwalang ɗun ǝngya ndang nanda kun ǝnon, ndaama, ‘Mafaya ni kan kee, ǝnanan tar nan.’ ”
Yeeso ƙǝnangɗǝ fa termeeya kum
Nanǝn ya na Yeeso a ɗǝrha Urshelima ɗǝ, tǝrghǝn kwamana kyagha tǝ ten sǝrǝk chehweed Samariya tǝ Nggalili.
Takh nǝn a kyarha hu tala hai, nafiya kum na tǝ wanhad termeerha ɓa nda ɓa isha nda ɗǝ inggun
aaghǝn nda ɗǝ tǝ urarha manggǝn, “Yeeso, Paɓa, a haɗowan fa!”
Nanǝn kanda, ndǝghǝn, “Ɗamaɗǝ ɗun kyaɗang fannun firistaya.” Kanda aten wiirha kee, ƙǝla nda hai ƙǝnda.
Tal ahur ndan, ƙǝla nǝn hai ƙǝnɗǝ, wudgha ɓa, tǝranggǝn uradghǝn sǝ kaan nagha a fal Faara.
Ɓaa ɓǝrgha hai a mbed Yeeso, usaghǝnǝn. Ndǝghǝnggi ƙǝm tǝ Samariyarha.
Tsakhka Yeeso mee, “Mbǝ kanda kum heu ƙǝngga wa? Ai fingya wutarihe?
Mbusǝ ko tǝ tǝtal wudgha ɓa ɓaa usa Faara wa ƙǝl rongɗiya?”
Tǝrgha ndangga Yeeso, “Thliu sǝ wiu; fǝrƙǝkafekkid wa ni ƙǝnowa.”
Tsakh mee aten ɓad Kutǝryid Faara ɓa
Na farɗa sǝ, Farisaya tsahang mee nda Yeeso, “A kwan na kutǝryid Faara a ɓarha ɓa.” Nggǝmangga Yeeso kanda ndǝghǝn, “Ai ɓad kutǝryid Faara ɓa, mbun naghǝn tǝ yirha wa.
Mbǝ fiya ndaarha, ‘Kulo ndǝghǝn ya,’ nduwa, ‘Kulo ndǝghǝn taarha,’ wa. Ƙǝsǝr kutǝryid Faara nǝghǝn ahur nun.”
Tǝrgha ndangga Yeeso fatsahayighǝn, “Na fara ɓayi na minnun ɓa tǝraa nang yirha Wan Niifa fa ko yi paara tal, amma mbun naghǝn wa.
Na fiya ndang nda kun, ‘Kulo ndǝghǝn taarha!’ nduwa, ‘Kulo ndǝghǝn ya!’ a ɗaɗun ɗǝ a samandan wa.
Ƙǝsǝr Wan Niifa a far wuttǝghǝn ɓa, nǝn naarha ƙǝla kyatta ˈyaara na djaara hai a fǝrakh amshi tsuwar mbǝya nǝn fa heu.
Amma nǝn a ˈwa taarang sǝsaarha fa ɗǝɗamǝn-ɗǝɗamǝn, tǝ ƙǝm nafiya ƙǝshiid weeriya nanda a karghǝn fa.
“Ƙǝla ˈwanǝn katǝrarha hai a thlakh mbǝd Nuhu, ɓanǝn naarha kee ƙǝm a far wutta Wan Niifa ɓa.
Fiya a hǝbrha tǝ sarha, hǝshya a kakhrha, kanda a fǝr nishya a chimadɗǝ ta farɗaɗǝ kyana Nuhu ahu kwambuwol hai. Tǝrgha ɓagha aam afa afa ɓa ɓǝlanggǝn kanda ɗǝ heu.”
Nǝghǝn wai kee a thlakh mbǝd Lutu. Fiya a hǝbrha tǝ sarha, kanda a hiirha tǝ hengnda ɗǝ, kanda a hǝfrha tǝ tǝnda.
Amma a farɗi malna Lutu Sodom, irr nda waarha hai tǝ tsal waarha a talara, ˈyanggǝn kanda ɗǝ heu.
“Ɓanǝn naarha ƙǝla yanɗiya a far wutta Wan Niifa ɓa.
A farɗi, mbǝ niifa naarha aten ƙǝnggǝn, tǝ karidghǝnsǝ a ƙǝn, mbǝ tǝraa hai ɓagha harang wa. Tǝ ƙǝm, mbǝ niifa ɗǝrha heeɗǝ ndagha nǝn wutta wure ɗǝ ka ɗǝgha har ǝngya wa.
Ɗalama teena hai tǝ ˈya walgha nu Lutu!
Kala niifa nggǝmngga yiɓǝdghǝn nǝn ƙǝɗengnda, yi ƙǝɗengga yiɓǝdghǝn, ɗǝfang nǝn ɗǝ.
Niya pǝranggǝn kun, a fǝɗikɗi na ǝnɗi a katǝrarha hai ya, nafiya sǝri kanda kalth ahu sǝra tal, na nda a tǝraa tal mal tal.
Nishya sǝri a hǝ hwarma kyab, nanda tǝraa tal takhka tal. Na hǝshya sǝri naarha a hee, nanda a tǝraa tal mal tal nda.”
Tsahang mee nda, “A yanggi na ǝnɗi katǝrarha hai ya, Chinǝm?” Ndanggǝn kanda, “Mbǝd mǝrra ˈya, mbǝd wumnda sǝkɗiyani.”
